The other formulas carry less iron: LiNi0.8Fe0.1Al0.1O2[2] (NFA 811[3]) and LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2[4] (NFA-A). In the rate capability test at the rate of 1C[5], NFA-F kept a capacity of ≈81 mAh g^− 1[6]. At the same rate the NFA-A variant kept ≈116 mAh g^− 1[7].
